clinic-prescription-assist v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides prescription assistance for primary care: drug recommendation, interaction checking, contraindication alerts, and dosage adjustment suggestions.
- Accepts patient diagnoses and relevant info; outputs structured JSON and natural language summary.
- Prioritizes essential medicines and includes patient monitoring & education tips.
- Built-in privacy: no local data storage, input de-identification, and minimum info principle.
- Usage requires Python 3.7+ (standard library only) and internal medical model API access.
- Output includes issue severity classification and tailored recommendations.
